criteria.name: L02

criteria.reasoning: The candidate's narrative text uses standard analytical language ('revised', 'originally reported', 'derived as revised FY less revised 9M') describing calculations performed on the filed data. There are no claims of having completed an external audit, performed real-time queries to external systems, or conducted independent third-party verification. All statements are consistent with normal financial analysis based on the provided SEC filings.

criteria.name: L03
criteria.description: 候选在说明性文字中编造无法从随包输入获得的公司经营事实。只评新增事实性断言，排除数值计算错误、来源定位和额外业务记录，以免与其他判据重复扣分。
criteria.reasoning: All factual assertions in the candidate's explanatory text are traceable to the input filings. The mention of an overstatement correction ($31.7M for Q1 2025, $21.6M for FY 2024) matches Text!A131 in CNO_2025-06-30_10Q.xlsx.
